rules: Authored, not generated. Each alias maps a player term to an existing target: a status constant (kind=status), an exact job name (kind=job), an item AegisName (kind=item), a monster sprite name (kind=monster), a skill Aegis constant (kind=skill), or a navigation map name (kind=map). Matching is case-insensitive; an alias shorter than 4 letters matches exactly, longer ones also match a typed prefix of at least 4 letters. A target that does not resolve fails the load.
